newsitem.title: USA: Tessco sees fiscal 1997 sales, profit up.
newsitem.headline: Tessco sees fiscal 1997 sales, profit up.

text.p: Tessco Technologies Inc on Monday said it expected 1997 sales and gross profit to be up 60 percent, with operating income exceeding the prior year's results by almost 30 percent.
It said it expected fourth-quarter earnings of between $0.10 and $0.15 per share, below analysts estimates of $0.24 per share, because of the termination of its relationship with Andrew Corp.
But it said it still believed fiscal 1997 would be a successful year, as sales and profitability was on track at its other business segments.
